body.query: How much seed funding did the storytelling studio Osmo announce in August 2026?

results.title: Osmo Gives Every Storyteller the Power of a Production Studio | Morningstar
highlights: Today, Osmo, the storytelling studio with a software factory, is making its end-to-end video product generally available to storytellers and GTM teams at high-growth companies. The company was founded by a team with backgrounds from A24, NBC, and Saturday Night Live. Osmo is also announcing a $5 million seed round led by Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Basis Set Ventures, MVP Ventures, Collaborative Fund, Scott Belsky, and others.

results.title: Osmo Studio Launches Video Platform with $5M Funding | Bain Capital Ventures (BCV) posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.author: Bain Capital Ventures (BCV)
highlights: Today, Osmo Studio announced the availability of its video platform and a $5M funding round that we are proud to lead. The team’s production studio has created more than 50 films for companies including Cognition, Physical Intelligence, and Gumloop. This gave them the experience to spot where AI could aid in the creative process. Instead of generating fixed AI outputs, Osmo creates editable code, giving teams more control over every element of the creative process while significantly reducing production time. Congratulations to Chris He, Will Hoppin, Basil Alfaro, Oleksandr Shevenionov and the entire Osmo team on giving every storyteller the power of a production studio.

results.title: AI startup Osmo wants to make corporate videos that don’t look like slop  - Fast Company
results.author: Steven Melendez
highlights: Osmo Studio, which bills itself as a “storytelling studio with a software factory” rather than a pure tech business, on Wednesday announced the general availability of its signature product, which generates short videos based on existing customer assets, including fonts, logos, product images, videos, and assets stored on platforms like Figma. Chris He, cofounder and CEO, says the goal is to enable marketers, sales staff, and other users to keep up with the breakneck pace of Silicon Valley launches without sacrificing the human element of storytelling.
